air_density.basis: p(10 m) moved hydrostatically to hub height, T(120 m), humidity from RH(10 m) at T(10 m)
air_density.note: covers 21 March - 8 November only (hot months); not an annual mean

aep_decomposition.step: ERA5 shape (k) with the transferred long-term mean speed

change_evidence.density_and_losses_note: both bases use #1530's 1.15 kg/m3 and 7.77% loss stack; sensitivity air_density_mast_record_mean shows the mast's own density

sensitivity_era5_shape_with_mast_mean.step: ERA5 shape (k) with the transferred long-term mean speed

hold: HOLD: not lender-grade. A 232-day, monsoon-weighted, pre-filtered and undocumented mast record, transferred 26.7 km through a reanalysis to a placeholder site. The met-mast package's HOLD on annual, P50/P90 and lender use stands.

mcp.sectored_by: reference (MERRA-2 WD50M at the mast cell) direction

reference.name: NASA POWER hourly (MERRA-2), parameters WS50M, WD50M, WS10M

shadow_flicker.method: rotor disc yawed to the long-term wind direction (month x sector, 5 yaw angles per sector), turning only when hub speed is in the curve's producing range, sunny steps only

measured.basis: 10-minute rows with all five mean speeds present, assessment window

site_transfer.basis: MERRA-2 turbine cell / mast cell, by mast-cell direction sector, long-term window

timezone.finding: mast clock = UTC+05:30 (Sri Lanka Standard Time)

yield.basis: frequency-weighted sector Weibulls at 130 m; curve clipped at 9.5 MW; #1530 density and losses
